$comment: CE-4600 B-3 (docs/DESIGN_Vehicle_Breaching.md B-D3, B-D4, D-3, V-9, R-4238, R-4243) — what a PLAYER-DRIVEN vehicle breaks by contact. STARTING VALUES, to be tuned. The FIRST row (file order) the vehicle qualifies for decides: a TRACKED vehicle (if 'tracked') of at least minMassKg. A barrier's STRENGTH = its material's resistanceMmRhaPerM x thickness (m) x height (m) (a wall panel's, an obstacle box's short side x height). A SMALL barrier (a free wall, a fence, a hedge, an obstacle) of strength <= smallMaxStrength breaks by a RAM (the step's speed into it >= minRamSpeedMs) or a PUSH (full throttle held in contact for pushSeconds) and the vehicle drives on keeping speedKept of its speed (never zero); the cut is the hull's footprint across the wall at its crossing angle + cutMarginM each side, at least minDriveThroughM, from the wall's base to its top. A BUILDING wall breaks only for a row with 'building', by a ram only (the bump): a door-sized Passage bumpWidthM x bumpHeightM, the hull held outside. costHealth is the damage the breaking vehicle takes (0: none in v1, B-D12). A vehicle no row takes breaks nothing (wheeled vehicles). CE-4629: 'dis' (kind.domain.country.category.subcategory, * any) limits a row to vehicles of that DIS type; a 'blade' row (the bulldozer, 1.1.*.9.1) bumping a BUILDING wall opens the blade's width (hull width + cutMarginM each side) at the wall's full height, centred on the hull, on every panel of the wall it spans; every bump is centred on the hull's centreline. CE-4603 (B-6, D-6 R-4241): 'trees' — the row fells a LONE tree trunk by the same ram or push (whatever its strength). CE-4623 AB-7 (Animals AR-5): CE-3473 (Checkpoint RM-5, user 2026-11-18): a 'ram' row is taken ONLY by a hull carrying an ACTIVE RamOrder (a car on RamTarget) — a WHEELED car breaks a small barrier (an empty drum 2.7, a chain-link fence, a hedge 30) by a ram at speed, never by a push; a filled drum (water 65, sand 86) holds it. An 'animal' row is taken ONLY by a PANICKED big animal (a species that breaks fences, fleeing in panic) and by nothing else — a small fence (wire 0.1, wood ~4, sheet ~1) by a ram at a run, never a hedge (~30) or a wall (brick ~200).
